title: Export with text-to-binary resource conversion injects `anchors_preset = 0` into instanced scene roots, resetting anchors and offsets at runtime
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable.mono.official.ed1daf0bf (Windows export with text→binary resource conversion enabled — the default). - Not tested in earlier versions (only 4.7.2 export templates are installed on this machine). Code inspection indicates this is not a recent regression: the responsible export path is still present in current master, and the `layout_mode`/`anchors_preset` property system that the injected overrides belong to was introduced in 4.0 by #55157. The editor-side family of this problem (#69226) has been confirmed by other reporters across 4.2.2 and 4.4.1. ### System information Windows 11 (10.0.22621) - Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono.official.ed1daf0bf - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 - 13th Gen Intel Core i5-13600KF (20 Threads) (Not graphics-related — the defect is in scene data conversion during export.) ### Issue description When a project is exported with `editor/export/convert_text_resources_to_binary` enabled (**the default**), the text→binary scene conversion writes a layout metadata override (`anchors_preset = 0`) onto **instanced scene root nodes that declare no layout properties in the source `.tscn`**. When the exported scene is loaded at runtime, this override is applied, resetting the instance root's anchors to top-left — full-rect instances collapse to 0×0 and custom offsets are rewritten. The editor and development runs read the source `.tscn` and are unaffected, so projects only discover this in release builds. Instancing an anchored/full-rect scene into another scene is a mainstream way to compose UI screens, so affected projects ship broken layouts in every exported build while the editor looks perfect. Probe evidence (the MRP prints the runtime state of both instance roots and the property overrides stored on them): Running in the editor / `godot --path .` (reads source scenes — correct): ``` FullRectChild anchors=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0) size=(1152.0, 648.0) RimChild anchors=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) offsets=(100.0, 100.0, 500.0, 400.0) Stored property overrides on instance roots: FullRectChild: [] RimChild: [] ``` Running the exported build (conversion on — the default): ``` FullRectChild anchors=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) size=(0.0, 0.0) RimChild anchors=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0) offsets=(0.0, 0.0, 400.0, 300.0) Stored property overrides on instance roots: FullRectChild: [anchors_preset=0] RimChild: [anchors_preset=0] ``` The instance roots gained an `anchors_preset = 0` override that **does not exist in the source `Main.tscn`** (the source stores zero overrides on these nodes). Applying preset 0 at load time also resets the offsets, which is why `RimChild`'s margins were rewritten from `(100, 100, 500, 400)` to `(0, 0, 400, 300)`. Running the exported build with `export/convert_text_resources_to_binary=false` in `project.godot` restores full correctness (output identical to the editor run), which confirms the damage is done by the conversion step. The responsible path appears to be scene customization during export: `_export_customize` instantiates the scene with `PackedScene::GEN_EDIT_STATE_INSTANCE` and re-packs it (`editor/export/editor_export_platform.cpp`, around line 1069 on current master): ```cpp Node *node = ps->instantiate(PackedScene::GEN_EDIT_STATE_INSTANCE); // Make sure the child scene root gets the correct inheritance chain. ``` Edit-state instantiation bakes editor layout metadata into the exported scene; for instance roots that never declared a layout override in the parent scene, this writes an `anchors_preset = 0` override into the package, which the runtime then applies as a real anchor reset. The author of #55157 anticipated exactly this class of side effect in review: > "They are supposed to be editor-only, but I can't make them fully editor-only with the flags that we have. I guess the only side-effect here would be that setting them can potentially reset some values?" Related issues: #69226 (the editor-side family of this problem — still open, no assignee) and #74360 (closed as its duplicate). I could not find an existing report for the **export conversion** variant of this injection, which is why projects hit it as a release-only layout regression. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Unzip the MRP below and open it in Godot 4.7 (three scenes + one ~25-line GDScript probe; no addons, no C#). `Main.tscn` instances two child scenes whose instance roots declare **no** layout properties: - `FullRectChild.tscn` — root `Control` with full-rect anchors (the "screen/background" pattern); - `RimChild.tscn` — root `Control` with zero anchors and custom offsets (the "decor/hover frame" pattern). 2. Run the project (F5). The probe prints anchors/offsets and the stored overrides — all correct. 3. Export *Windows Desktop* with default settings (conversion on). 4. Run the exported executable and compare the probe output with step 2 (broken output shown in "Issue description"). ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) MRP source files (pure GDScript, ~3 KB total, `.godot` folder not required): https://gist.github.com/jinsediaoying/e7cc7b0c1d145b775b9fe6818aa6e1c1 — six files (`project.godot`, `export_presets.cfg`, three `.tscn`, one `.gd`), copy into a folder and open in Godot 4.7. Full source also inline below. Full source inline (for reviewers who prefer not to unpack):
Main.tscn ```text [gd_scene load_steps=4 format=3] [ext_resource type="Script" path="res://Main.gd" id="3_probe"] [ext_resource type="PackedScene" path="res://FullRectChild.tscn" id="1_full"] [ext_resource type="PackedScene" path="res://RimChild.tscn" id="2_rim"] [node name="Main" type="Control"] anchors_preset = 15 anchor_right = 1.0 anchor_bottom = 1.0 grow_horizontal = 2 grow_vertical = 2 script = ExtResource("3_probe") [node name="FullRectChild" parent="." instance=ExtResource("1_full")] [node name="RimChild" parent="." instance=ExtResource("2_rim")] ```
FullRectChild.tscn ```text [gd_scene format=3] [node name="FullRectChild" type="Control"] anchors_preset = 15 anchor_right = 1.0 anchor_bottom = 1.0 grow_horizontal = 2 grow_vertical = 2 [node name="Background" type="ColorRect" parent="."] color = Color(0.35, 0.1, 0.1, 1) ```
RimChild.tscn ```text [gd_scene format=3] [node name="RimChild" type="Control"] offset_left = 100.0 offset_top = 100.0 offset_right = 500.0 offset_bottom = 400.0 [node name="Rim" type="ColorRect" parent="."] anchors_preset = 15 anchor_right = 1.0 anchor_bottom = 1.0 grow_horizontal = 2 grow_vertical = 2 color = Color(0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 1) ```
Main.gd (probe) ```gdscript extends Control func _ready() -> void: var full_rect := $FullRectChild as Control var rim := $RimChild as Control print("== Runtime state ==") print("FullRectChild anchors=(", full_rect.anchor_left, ", ", full_rect.anchor_top, ", ", full_rect.anchor_right, ", ", full_rect.anchor_bottom, ") size=", full_rect.size) print("RimChild anchors=(", rim.anchor_left, ", ", rim.anchor_top, ", ", rim.anchor_right, ", ", rim.anchor_bottom, ") offsets=(", rim.offset_left, ", ", rim.offset_top, ", ", rim.offset_right, ", ", rim.offset_bottom, ")") print("== Stored property overrides on instance roots (PackedScene.get_state) ==") var state := (load("res://Main.tscn") as PackedScene).get_state() for i in state.get_node_count(): var node_name := state.get_node_name(i) if node_name == "FullRectChild" or node_name == "RimChild": var props: Array[String] = [] for p in state.get_node_property_count(i): props.append(str(state.get_node_property_name(i, p), "=", state.get_node_property_value(i, p))) print(node_name, ": [", ", ".join(props), "]") get_tree().quit() ```
`project.godot` is a minimal application config (main scene + name, no conversion setting — demonstrating default behavior), and `export_presets.cfg` contains a default *Windows Desktop* preset.
